title_sq: Tek Rruga Mine Peza, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2, Me Lokacion Ideal!!!
description_sq: Tek Rruga Mine Peza, shitet apartament 3+1+2 me lokacion ideal. Prona ka nje siperfaqe prej 120 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin e fundit te nje pallati 5-katesh. title_en: On Mine Peza Street, 3+1+2 Apartment For Sale, With Ideal Location!!!
description_en: On Mine Peza Street, a 3+1+2 apartment for sale with an ideal location. The property has an area of ​​120 m2 and is located on the top floor of a 5-story building. The apartment is fully furnished and is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 storage rooms. The terrace with an area of ​​111.71 m2 is also in use, as well as 2 parking spaces below the building. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most preferred areas of Tirana for living, as well as offering all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
